import json, urllib.request
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/chat",
    data=json.dumps({
        "task_key": "TASK-11",
        "author": "user",
        "message": "Audit remediation re-sync: 1. TASK-A04: Fix OCC _source_ts + BulkWrite SetOrdered(false); 2. TASK-A05: Fix UUID BinData:04 & dec.Quad/Decimal128; 3. TASK-A06: Fix Recon JSONB canonical sort + GetMasterAgent routing; 4. TASK-A07: Fix Heal Mongo upsert/soft-delete."
    }).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
    chat_res = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-11", timeout=10) as r:
    dash = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
subtasks = dash.get("active_sub_tasks", [])
done_ids = [s["sub_task_id"] for s in subtasks if s["status"] == "done"]
pending_ids = [s["sub_task_id"] for s in subtasks if s["status"] != "done"]
a_titles = [(s["sub_task_id"], s["title"], s.get("target_files","")) for s in subtasks if s["sub_task_id"].startswith("TASK-A")]
print(f"stage={dash.get(\"active_task_stage\")} total_subtasks={len(subtasks)} done={len(done_ids)} ({done_ids}) pending={len(pending_ids)} ({pending_ids})")
for sid, t, tf in a_titles:
    print(f"  {sid}: title={t!r} target_files={tf!r}")
assert dash.get("active_task_stage") == "NEEDS_YOU", f"expected NEEDS_YOU, got {dash.get(\"active_task_stage\")}"
assert len(pending_ids) >= 7, f"expected pending subtasks >= 7, got {pending_ids}"
for sid, t, tf in a_titles:
    assert "TASK-A" not in t, f"SA-04 duplicate prefix in {sid}: {t}"
    assert tf != "", f"empty target_files in {sid}"
